findings.title: [P2] Keep instrumentation out of the ordinary benchmark artifact
findings.body: When benchmarks run (including pushes to `main`, where `Skip benchmarks` does not apply), this flag also instruments `gen/runtron`, which `ci-bundle-artifact.sh` publishes and `ci-run-benchmark.sh` measures through `--prebuilt`. The artifact-miss fallback instead invokes `make clean` and `make gen/config/test`, leaving this option OFF, yet both paths cache results under the same source hash. Software-attention timings therefore depend on artifact availability and can include the extra per-page accounting and shared atomic updates rather than measure the default build. Keep the ON hook-coverage build separate from the OFF artifact used for ordinary benchmarks.

overall_explanation: The counter logic passes its 61 assertions, but the CI benchmark artifact now includes instrumentation while clean fallback builds do not. This makes performance measurements depend on artifact availability rather than a consistent build configuration.
